# `fnox get`

- **Usage:** `fnox get [--base64-decode] [--refresh] <KEY>`

Get a secret value

## Arguments

- **`<KEY>`** — Secret key to retrieve

## Flags

- **`--base64-decode`** — Base64 decode the secret
- **`--refresh`** — Re-resolve the secret from its provider instead of serving it from the daemon cache, and cache the new value
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Print one resolved value to stdout. Use check --all when you only need to verify access without displaying the secret.

```sh
fnox get DATABASE_URL
fnox get DATABASE_URL --profile staging
```
